mock_data.title: Bridge Delay
mock_data.passage:
Interviewer: Mr Jones, I am sure that you are aware that commuters in the area are growing very concerned about the delay in opening the new bridge across the Brunton. It is already nearly a year overdue. The ferry service has been greatly reduced in anticipation of this opening and people have been greatly inconvenienced. They say that they are tired of being promised jam tomorrow and want to be given a definite opening date. Are you able to supply this?

MP: Unfortunately, I am not in a position to do so at this moment in time. What I can tell you is that a committee has been set up to look into the matter and that this committee will report to us in due course. At this juncture, we can say that there have been a number of unexpected teething troubles, but we are unaware of the exact nature of these. Of course, we very much regret the delay and the position which commuters now find themselves in.

Interviewer: Meanwhile, Mr Jones, people are having to drive miles to get to work because they cannot get across the river. It appears that the ferry companies jumped the gun when they so drastically reduced the service across the river.

MP: The ferry company's decision was a commercial one and is in no way the responsibility of the government or, indeed, of the local authority. Far be it from me either to criticize or defend their decision, but business is business and presumably they wished to avoid substantial losses by providing too many ferry boats for the numbers using them. It is easy to be wise after the event, but their decision was made as a result of the original building forecast.

Interviewer: In view of the inconvenience caused to the public, is it not possible for the government to intervene to try to persuade the ferry company to reintroduce their original service temporarily until the bridge is actually opened?

MP: We will give this our earnest consideration, but not until we have had the report of the committee which is investigating the state of play on the building of the bridge. In the meantime, I must urge everyone to be patient. The splendid new bridge will mark the beginning of a new era for our area and I can assure you that it will be worth waiting for.
mock_data.passageB1:
Interviewer: Mr. Jones, people who travel in this area are very worried about the new bridge over the Brunton River. It should have opened almost a year ago. The ferry service is now much smaller because everyone thought the bridge would be open. This has made things very difficult for people. They are tired of waiting and want to know exactly when the bridge will open. Can you tell us?

MP: I can't give you a date right now. But, we have a group looking at the problem. They will tell us what is happening soon. We know there have been some unexpected problems, but we don't know what they are. We are very sorry for the delay and the problems it is causing.

Interviewer: People have to drive many miles to get to work because they can't cross the river easily. It seems the ferry companies made a mistake when they made the ferry service so much smaller.

MP: The ferry company's choice was a business decision. It is not the government's or the local council's responsibility. I don't want to say if their decision was good or bad. But, they probably wanted to avoid losing money by having too many ferries for the people using them. It's easy to say what they should have done now, but they made their decision based on when they thought the bridge would be finished.

Interviewer: Because this is causing problems for people, can the government ask the ferry company to use the original, bigger service again? This would only be until the bridge is open.

MP: We will seriously consider this. But, we need to wait for the report from the group looking at the bridge. In the meantime, please be patient. The new bridge will be great for this area. I promise it will be worth the wait. We need to find a solution to this difficult situation. We are trying to improve the situation for everyone. The lack of communication hasn't helped, but we are working hard to resolve these issues and complete the project.
mock_data.passageB2:
Interviewer: Mr. Jones, local residents are becoming increasingly concerned about the delays in opening the new Brunton bridge. It's almost a year behind schedule. The ferry service was significantly reduced in anticipation of the bridge opening, causing considerable inconvenience. People are frustrated with empty promises and want a firm opening date. Can you provide one?

MP: I'm unfortunately unable to give you a specific date right now. However, I can confirm that a committee has been established to investigate the situation. They will present their findings in due course. Currently, we know that there have been some unforeseen complications, though we don't yet know the details. We sincerely regret the delay and the difficulties commuters are experiencing.

Interviewer: Meanwhile, Mr. Jones, people are forced to drive long distances to get to work because they can't cross the river. It seems the ferry companies acted prematurely when they drastically cut their service.

MP: The ferry company's decision was a commercial matter and not the responsibility of the government or local council. I wouldn't want to criticize or defend their choice, but businesses must operate efficiently, and they likely wanted to avoid heavy losses by running too many ferries for the number of passengers. It's easy to judge after the fact, but their decision was based on the original construction timeline. Their decision was based on the initial projected completion date.

Interviewer: Given the inconvenience to the public, could the government intervene and persuade the ferry company to temporarily restore its original service until the bridge opens?

MP: We will seriously consider this, but only after we've received the committee's report on the bridge's construction progress. In the meantime, I urge everyone to be patient. This new bridge will usher in a new era for our area, and I assure you it will be worth the wait. We are committed to resolving this issue as quickly as possible and minimizing disruption to daily life.
mock_data.passageC1:
Public disquiet is mounting, Mr. Jones, regarding the protracted delay in the Brunton River bridge project. Commuters are increasingly voicing their frustration, with the bridge now almost a year behind schedule. The scaling back of the ferry service, implemented in anticipation of the bridge’s imminent opening, has only exacerbated the problem. They are demanding a definitive opening date, expressing weariness with vague promises of future improvements. Can you provide one?

I regret to inform you that I am not presently in a position to furnish a specific date. A dedicated committee has been tasked with thoroughly investigating the situation, and their findings will be presented to us in due course. At this stage, we can acknowledge the emergence of unforeseen technical hitches. While the precise nature of these issues remains unclear, we are acutely aware of, and genuinely regret, the inconvenience and disruption experienced by commuters. Rest assured, we are working diligently to resolve them.

Meanwhile, Mr. Jones, the current situation forces many to undertake significantly longer journeys to reach their workplaces, a direct consequence of the compromised river crossing. It appears the ferry operators may have acted prematurely in drastically reducing their service. Did they not?

The ferry company’s decision was a purely commercial one, and falls outside the remit of both governmental and local authority control. While I would neither presume to criticize nor seek to justify their actions, it is reasonable to assume they aimed to mitigate potential financial losses by aligning service provision with projected demand. Hindsight is always 20/20, but their decision was predicated on the original construction timeline. The ferry company's decision was a calculated risk.

Given the considerable inconvenience inflicted upon the public, would it not be feasible for the government to exert its influence and encourage the ferry company to temporarily reinstate its original service until the bridge is fully operational? This would go some way towards alleviating the current disruption.

We will give this matter our most serious consideration, but only after we have received and thoroughly reviewed the report from the committee investigating the impediments to the bridge's completion. In the meantime, I implore everyone to exercise patience. This new bridge represents a significant step forward for our region, and I can assure you that the long-term benefits will outweigh the current difficulties. Once complete, commuters will reap the benefits of reduced travel times and improved connectivity.

questions.answer: A member of parliament (MP) is an elected representative who serves in the legislative body of a government, typically called parliament. They represent the people in their constituency/district, debate and vote on laws, discuss government policies, and address concerns of their constituents.
questions.question: What is a member of parliament?

questions.answer: Members of parliament debate and pass laws, represent their constituents' interests, scrutinize government actions, vote on policies and budgets, attend committee meetings, address local issues, and participate in parliamentary debates. They serve as a link between citizens and the government.
questions.question: What does a member of parliament do?

questions.answer: An MP might be interviewed to: explain government policies, respond to public concerns, discuss current events or issues affecting their constituency, clarify positions on controversial topics, announce new initiatives, address criticisms, or provide updates on important projects or developments.
questions.question: Why would a member of parliament be interviewed?

imageCredit.alt: A steel bridge spans a waterway in Tokyo, showcasing modern architectural engineering.

mock_data.translation:
Suhbatdosh: Janob Jons, ishonchim komilki, siz hududdagi yo'lovchilar Brunton ustidan yangi ko'prik ochilishining kechikishi haqida juda tashvishlanayotganlarini bilasiz. U allaqachon deyarli bir yil kechikmoqda. Parom xizmati bu ochilishni kutgan holda sezilarli darajada qisqartirildi va odamlar juda ko'p noqulayliklarga duch kelishdi. Ular ertaga murabbo va'da berilishidan charchashganini aytishadi va aniq ochilish sanasini berishni talab qilishmoqda. Siz buni ta'minlay olasizmi?

Deputat: Afsuski, men ayni paytda buni qila olmayman. Men sizga ayta oladigan narsa shuki, masalani o'rganish uchun qo'mita tashkil etilgan va bu qo'mita bizga o'z vaqtida hisobot beradi. Hozirgi paytda biz kutilmagan bir qator tish chiqarish muammolari bo'lganini ayta olamiz, ammo biz bularning aniq tabiatidan bexabarmiz. Albatta, biz kechikishdan va yo'lovchilar hozir o'zlarini topgan vaziyatdan juda afsuslanamiz.

Suhbatdosh: Ayni paytda, janob Jons, odamlar ishga borish uchun bir necha mil haydashga majbur, chunki ular daryodan o'tib bo'lmaydi. Ko'rinishidan, parom kompaniyalari daryo bo'ylab xizmatni shunchalik keskin qisqartirganda shoshilvchi bo'lgan.

Deputat: Parom kompaniyasining qarori tijorat qarori bo'lgan va bu hech qanday tarzda hukumat yoki mahalliy hokimiyatning mas'uliyati emas. Men ularning qarorini tanqid qilish yoki himoya qilishdan uzoqman, ammo biznes bu biznes va ehtimol ular ulardan foydalanayotgan sonlar uchun juda ko'p parom qayiqlarini taqdim etish orqali katta yo'qotishlardan qochishni xohlashgan. Voqeadan keyin dono bo'lish oson, ammo ularning qarori asl qurilish prognozi natijasida qabul qilingan.

Suhbatdosh: Jamoatchilikka yetkazilgan noqulaylik nuqtai nazaridan, hukumat parom kompaniyasini ko'prik haqiqatda ochilguncha vaqtincha asl xizmatini qayta joriy etishga ko'ndirish uchun aralashish mumkin emasmi?

Deputat: Biz buni jiddiy ko'rib chiqamiz, ammo ko'prik qurilishidagi hozirgi vaziyatni tekshirayotgan qo'mita hisobotini olgunimizcha emas. Ayni paytda, men hammani sabr-toqatli bo'lishga chaqiraman. Ajoyib yangi ko'prik bizning hududimiz uchun yangi davrning boshlanishini belgilaydi va sizni ishontirib aytamanki, uni kutish arziydi.

mock_data.translationB1:
Intervyu oluvchi: Janob Jons, bu hududda sayohat qiladigan odamlar Brunton daryosi ustidagi yangi ko'prik haqida juda xavotirda. U deyarli bir yil oldin ochilishi kerak edi. Parom xizmati hozir ancha kichrayib ketdi, chunki hamma ko'prik ochiladi deb o'ylagan edi. Bu odamlarga juda qiyin bo'ldi. Ular kutishdan charchashdi va ko'prik qachon ochilishini aniq bilishni xohlashadi. Bizga ayta olasizmi?

Deputat: Men sizga hozircha aniq sanani ayta olmayman. Ammo, bizda muammoni ko'rib chiqayotgan bir guruh bor. Ular tez orada nima bo'layotganini aytishadi. Bizda ba'zi kutilmagan muammolar bo'lganini bilamiz, lekin ular nima ekanligini bilmaymiz. Biz kechikish va u keltirib chiqarayotgan muammolar uchun juda afsusdamiz.

Intervyu oluvchi: Odamlar daryodan osonlikcha o'ta olmayotgani sababli ishga borish uchun ko'p kilometr yurishga majbur. Parom kompaniyalari parom xizmatini juda kichraytirganda xato qilishgandek tuyuladi.

Deputat: Parom kompaniyasining tanlovi biznes qarori edi. Bu hukumatning yoki mahalliy kengashning mas'uliyati emas. Men ularning qarori yaxshi yoki yomon bo'lganini aytmoqchi emasman. Ammo, ular, ehtimol, ulardan foydalanayotgan odamlar uchun juda ko'p paromga ega bo'lish orqali pul yo'qotishdan qochishni xohlashgan. Hozir nima qilishlari kerakligini aytish oson, lekin ular o'z qarorlarini ko'prik qachon tugashiga qarab qabul qilishdi.

Intervyu oluvchi: Bu odamlarga muammo tug'dirayotgani sababli, hukumat parom kompaniyasidan asl, kattaroq xizmatni qayta ishlatishni so'rashi mumkinmi? Bu faqat ko'prik ochilgunga qadar bo'ladi.

Deputat: Biz buni jiddiy ko'rib chiqamiz. Ammo, biz ko'prikni ko'rib chiqayotgan guruhdan hisobotni kutishimiz kerak. Shu bilan birga, iltimos, sabrli bo'ling. Yangi ko'prik bu hudud uchun ajoyib bo'ladi. Va'da beraman, bu kutishga arziydi. Biz bu qiyin vaziyatga yechim topishimiz kerak. Biz hamma uchun vaziyatni yaxshilashga harakat qilmoqdamiz. Aloqa yetishmasligi yordam bermadi, lekin biz bu muammolarni hal qilish va loyihani yakunlash uchun qattiq ishlamoqdamiz.
mock_data.translationB2:
Intervyu oluvchi: Janob Jons, mahalliy aholi yangi Brunton ko'prigining ochilishi kechikayotganidan tobora ko'proq xavotirlanmoqda. Deyarli bir yilga kechikyapti. Parom qatnovi ko'prik ochilishini kutib sezilarli darajada qisqartirildi, bu esa ancha noqulaylik tug'dirdi. Odamlar bajarilmagan va'dalardan hafsalasi pir bo'lgan va aniq ochilish sanasini bilishni xohlashadi. Siz buni aytib bera olasizmi?

Deputat: Afsuski, hozir sizga aniq sanani ayta olmayman. Biroq, men vaziyatni o'rganish uchun qo'mita tuzilganini tasdiqlay olaman. Ular o'z xulosalarini tegishli vaqtda taqdim etishadi. Hozircha, bizga ma'lumki, ba'zi kutilmagan murakkabliklar yuzaga kelgan, ammo tafsilotlarni hali bilmaymiz. Kechikish va qatnovchilar duch kelayotgan qiyinchiliklar uchun chin dildan afsusdamiz.

Intervyu oluvchi: Ayni paytda, janob Jons, odamlar daryodan o'ta olmagani uchun ishga borish uchun uzoq masofalarni bosib o'tishga majbur. Parom kompaniyalari o'z qatnovlarini keskin qisqartirganda shoshqaloqlik qilganga o'xshaydi.

Deputat: Parom kompaniyasining qarori tijorat masalasi bo'lib, hukumat yoki mahalliy kengashning mas'uliyati emas. Men ularning tanqid qilishni ham, himoya qilishni ham xohlamayman, lekin biznes samarali ishlashi kerak va ular yo'lovchilar soni uchun juda ko'p parom qatnovini amalga oshirib, katta yo'qotishlarga yo'l qo'ymaslikni xohlagan bo'lishi mumkin. Keyin baho berish oson, lekin ularning qarori dastlabki qurilish muddatiga asoslangan edi. Ularning qarori dastlabki rejalashtirilgan yakunlanish sanasiga asoslangan edi.

Intervyu oluvchi: Aholiga noqulaylik tug'dirganini hisobga olib, hukumat aralashib, parom kompaniyasini ko'prik ochilguncha o'zining asl qatnovini vaqtincha tiklashga ko'ndira oladimi?

Deputat: Biz buni jiddiy ko'rib chiqamiz, lekin faqat ko'prik qurilishi bo'yicha qo'mitaning hisobotini olganimizdan keyin. Shu bilan birga, men hammadan sabrli bo'lishni so'rayman. Bu yangi ko'prik hududimiz uchun yangi davrni boshlab beradi va sizni ishontirib aytamanki, bunga arziydi. Biz ushbu muammoni imkon qadar tezroq hal qilishga va kundalik hayotga aralashuvni kamaytirishga sodiqmiz.
mock_data.translationC1:
Jamoatchilikning noroziligi, janob Jons, Brunton daryosi ko‘prigi loyihasining cho‘zilib ketayotgan muddati tufayli kuchaymoqda. Qatnovchilar tobora ko‘proq norozilik bildirmoqda, chunki ko‘prik hozirda deyarli bir yilga kechikmoqda. Ko‘prikning yaqin orada ochilishini kutgan holda amalga oshirilgan parom xizmatining qisqartirilishi muammoni yanada kuchaytirdi. Ular aniq ochilish sanasini talab qilmoqda va kelajakdagi yaxshilanishlar haqidagi noaniq va'dalardan charchaganliklarini bildirishmoqda. Shunday sanani ayta olasizmi?

Afsuski, hozirda aniq sanani aytishga qodir emasman. Vaziyatni har tomonlama o‘rganish uchun maxsus qo‘mita tashkil etilgan va ularning xulosalari bizga vaqti kelganda taqdim etiladi. Hozirgi bosqichda biz kutilmagan texnik nosozliklar yuzaga kelganini tan olishimiz mumkin. Ushbu muammolarning aniq tabiati noma'lum bo'lsa-da, biz qatnovchilar tomonidan boshdan kechirilgan noqulayliklar va uzilishlardan juda yaxshi xabardormiz va chin dildan afsusdamiz. Ishonchimiz komilki, biz ularni hal qilish uchun astoydil harakat qilmoqdamiz.

Ayni paytda, janob Jons, hozirgi vaziyat ko'pchilikni ish joylariga borish uchun ancha uzoq yo'llarni bosib o'tishga majbur qilmoqda, bu daryoning buzilgan kesib o'tishining bevosita oqibatidir. Ko'rinishidan, parom operatorlari xizmatlarini keskin qisqartirishda shoshilishgan bo'lishi mumkin. Shunday emasmi?

Parom kompaniyasining qarori butunlay tijorat qarori bo'lib, hukumat va mahalliy hokimiyatning vakolatidan tashqarida. Men ularning harakatlarini tanqid qilmoqchi ham, oqlamoqchi ham emasman, lekin ularning xizmat ko'rsatishni kutilayotgan talabga moslashtirish orqali potentsial moliyaviy zararni kamaytirishni maqsad qilgan deb taxmin qilish o'rinli. O'tmishga nazar solsak, hamma narsa aniq ko'rinadi, lekin ularning qarori asl qurilish jadvaliga asoslangan edi. Parom kompaniyasining qarori hisoblangan tavakkalchilik edi.

Jamoatchilikka yetkazilgan katta noqulayliklarni hisobga olgan holda, hukumat o'z ta'sirini o'tkazib, parom kompaniyasini ko'prik to'liq ishga tushgunga qadar vaqtincha o'zining asl xizmatini tiklashga undashi mumkin emasmi? Bu hozirgi uzilishlarni ma'lum darajada bartaraf etishga yordam beradi.

Biz bu masalani juda jiddiy ko'rib chiqamiz, lekin faqat ko'prikning qurilishini to'xtatib turgan omillarni o'rganayotgan qo'mitaning hisobotini olganimizdan va uni sinchiklab ko'rib chiqqanimizdan keyingina. Ayni paytda, men hammadan sabr qilishni so'rayman. Ushbu yangi ko'prik bizning mintaqamiz uchun muhim qadamdir va men sizni ishontirib aytamanki, uzoq muddatli foyda hozirgi qiyinchiliklardan ustun keladi. Qurilish tugallangach, qatnovchilar sayohat vaqtining qisqarishi va aloqaning yaxshilanishi foydasini ko'rishadi.
